limits: Four deterministic paired cases, no statistical replicates.
Exact operator future geometry; no forecast-error or notification implementation.
Queue statistics are served device visits including ACKs; not end-to-end queue RTT.
Drop hook layers and BBR sampled loss bytes are not unique packet-loss or retransmission counts.
Internal measured RTprop and ProbeRTT are unchanged; only normal ProbeBW cwnd target BDP RTT changes.
40s cutoff, first route shortening; not a 200s/other-route generalization.
TcpBbr is the provided BBRv1 family, not modern BBRv3.
Operator hints are ideal geometry information; two-direction propagation RTT does not prove queue clearance.
RTprop installations are accepted TCP lastRtt samples, which may be quantized and cache the latest RTT observation; no geometry value is installed.
Per served device-queue visit includes zero waits and both data/ACK directions, not end-to-end queue latency.
Drop layers are hook-event counts, not distinct physical packet losses.
Sparse bbr_state rows are sample-hold traces; exact ProbeRTT lifecycle is separately instrumented.
Early filter invalidation is the policy; filter length remains ten seconds and the original measurement conditions are retained.
No random repetitions, competition, predictor error study or deployment validation.

allowed_report_claims.text: At T26.2, the route changes from 12 to 10 links, with 3.315759 ms same-instant one-way shortening; baseline has three retransmissions within one recovery episode.
Natural 200 s goodput changes from 9.544356 to 9.5465088 Mbps; first-event retransmissions/recoveries change from 3/1 to 0/0. The tail action is inert in the 100 GB bulk flow.
The tail extension repairs FCT from 0.350482400 to 0.257223678 s, but remains 5.713758 ms slower than unmodified TCP at 0.251509920 s.
The full and stopped source queue causes exact TrafficControl rejection; the T75 route switch is not necessary under the fixed policy.
Known-capacity pacing is an opt-in long-bulk setting with an 83.27814% finite-FCT cost; preserve default OFF.
